purpose: Describe how a user can realistically operate an investing system over time.

guided_autopilot.name: Guided Autopilot
guided_autopilot.summary: A mostly automated investing system with clear explanations and attention only when something meaningfully changes.

resultCopy.headline: Your investing style is Guided Autopilot.
resultCopy.summary: You are most likely to stay consistent when your portfolio has a clear structure, runs mostly in the background, and asks for your attention only when a meaningful decision is required.
resultCopy.whatThisMeans: Your system should automate routine behavior, explain why a change is or is not needed, and avoid creating work merely to make the portfolio feel active.
resultCopy.watchOut: A low-maintenance system still needs defined review points. AaronBux should help you notice genuine changes without turning normal market movement into an alert.

steady_steward.name: Steady Steward
steady_steward.summary: A durable portfolio reviewed occasionally with disciplined, limited changes.

operatingProfile.reviewCadence: Quarterly light review and annual full review

resultCopy.headline: Your investing style is Steady Steward.
resultCopy.summary: You appear comfortable staying involved as long as the portfolio does not demand constant attention.
resultCopy.whatThisMeans: Your system should be durable enough to leave alone between reviews, but transparent enough that you can understand and approve important adjustments.
resultCopy.watchOut: Occasional review can become piecemeal decision-making if the portfolio does not have an explicit structure.

systematic_improver.name: Systematic Improver
systematic_improver.summary: A repeatable process for reviewing, comparing, and improving the portfolio.

operatingProfile.reviewCadence: Monthly monitoring and quarterly decision review
operatingProfile.monitoringMode: Allocation, factor, cost, concentration, and rule-based signals

resultCopy.headline: Your investing style is Systematic Improver.
resultCopy.summary: You are most likely to trust a portfolio when its decisions follow a repeatable method.
resultCopy.whatThisMeans: AaronBux should give you structured comparisons, clear allocation ranges, and a record of why each change was made.
resultCopy.watchOut: A repeatable process can still become over-optimization. Every additional strategy should earn its place.

bounded_explorer.name: Bounded Explorer
bounded_explorer.summary: A stable core with controlled room to research and test selected ideas.

operatingProfile.reviewCadence: Monthly opportunity review and quarterly portfolio review
operatingProfile.changeThreshold: Moderate within sleeve and high for core
operatingProfile.automationPreference: High for core and low-medium for sleeve

resultCopy.headline: Your investing style is Bounded Explorer.
resultCopy.summary: You want more than a basic portfolio, but you also want a structure that prevents every new idea from reshaping your financial plan.
resultCopy.whatThisMeans: AaronBux should help you evaluate ideas in the context of your full portfolio and preserve a clear sleeve budget.
resultCopy.watchOut: The main risk is allowing individually reasonable ideas to accumulate into an unplanned portfolio.

active_navigator.name: Active Navigator
active_navigator.summary: A defined framework for making more frequent, market-aware decisions without losing portfolio boundaries.

operatingProfile.monitoringMode: Market, valuation, catalyst, risk, and exposure signals
operatingProfile.automationPreference: Low for decisions and high for guardrails

requiredRules: At least two independent active-decision signals
Effort must be medium-high or high

resultCopy.headline: Your investing style is Active Navigator.
resultCopy.summary: You want an investing system that allows you to respond to changing conditions rather than follow a fully static plan.
resultCopy.whatThisMeans: AaronBux should help you define the thesis, size, trigger, and exit conditions for each active decision while protecting the long-term portfolio.
resultCopy.watchOut: The central risk is allowing frequent decisions to replace a coherent portfolio process.

rules: Active Navigator requires at least two independent active-decision signals.
Bounded Explorer requires exploration interest and a boundary signal.
Systematic Improver requires a rule, comparison, or repeatable-strategy signal.
Validation Seeker customizes support and never independently selects a style.
Time horizon does not directly score investment style.
